translation: Or when [fluids] stagnate and accumulate and damp-heat is severe within, unable to be transmitted and transformed, it changes into water swelling and abdominal distension. In general, much drinking with frequent urination is wasting-thirst (消渴); much eating with frequent urination is wasting-midst (消中); emaciation of the flesh and muscles with fatty fluid in the urine is wasting-kidney (消腎). These are the three wasting diseases (三消) transmitted in the world. Although not recorded in antiquity, when examined against the Neijing (內經), they are merely the slight and severe [degrees] of dryness-heat.
translator_notes: 三消 rendered as 'three wasting diseases'.
小便有脂液 rendered as 'fatty fluid in the urine'.
